product_one_liner.value: Reveal provides an AI-powered eDiscovery and investigations platform for corporate legal teams, law firms, legal service providers, government, and education.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its AI-powered platform and names these audiences.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the homepage navigation/footer; the contact page offers general inquiries and demos rather than public pricing or plans.

named_customers.notes: All three are named in Reveal's customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: Inc's company profile gives a 201–500 company-size band. Reveal's About page separately says 500+ employees, so published estimates vary.

hq_location.notes: Reveal identifies its North American headquarters in Chicago.

founded_year.notes: Reveal's official company history and Inc's profile identify 2008.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is primarily eDiscovery, AI, and industry guidance. It does not establish at least two posts about how the product is built by engineers.

public_docs.notes: Reveal has public documentation for multiple products, with numerous documentation sections and articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists roles, but none has AI, machine learning, or data science in its title.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed public product documentation, AI-related pages, blog search results, and the Trust Center/subprocessor material; none publicly identifies the model provider used by Reveal's own AI product. References to Claude/ChatGPT connectors concern collecting users' AI conversations, not the provider Reveal uses for its own AI.

compliance_certs.notes: Reveal's Trust Center and company page name SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001; the Trust Center also lists GDPR.

last_funding.notes: Reveal's company history says it received a $250 million investment from K1 Investment Management in January 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding/investment identified in Reveal's company history was in January 2021, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board includes an Account Executive II posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Reveal announced the Onna Claude Connector on October 20, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The verified CEO transition announcement is dated October 14, 2025, before the 12-month window that began November 9, 2025. I could not verify a complete, sufficiently small current leadership roster or a later appointment/departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Reveal's integrations page and Salesforce integration page explicitly identify Salesforce.
